summary: Passed bounded independent review. Compared CSS and favicon directly with the supplied before files and inspected the theme tests and DESIGN.md. No security issue, recoloring-induced functional layout regression, leftover dark content surface, or unreadable recolored text was identified. Cyan/violet/amber token names intentionally preserve existing semantic references. Favicon geometry is unchanged; only fills differ. CSS adds no external resource or executable constructs. Additional checks of text on table, diagram, code, and action-link surfaces yielded contrast ratios of 4.81:1 or higher. The known narrow nonmobile min-content overflow is a supplied before-and-after baseline issue, not a recoloring regression; the single-column grid minmax(0,1fr) change appropriately addresses the affected tracks. Assertions are meaningful representative checks, not exhaustive accessibility coverage. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passed all 4 tests. No separate E2E suite, web research, delegation, or production edits were performed; full visual/interaction confirmation remains with the parent's E2E run.
